subject: Wrexham owners Reynolds and Mac watch 1-1 draw with Wolves at the Racecourse
title: Wrexham's owners and a late equaliser

lines.vo: Hollywood came to Wrexham, and Wrexham took a point.
lines.footage: Ryan Reynolds Rob McElhenney Racecourse Ground

lines.vo: Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney watched the one-all draw with Wolves.
Adam Armstrong put Wolves ahead. Lewis O'Brien equalised, his first goal of the season. Two film stars were watching.
It denied Wolves sole top spot.
Phil Parkinson says the owners' visits lift players, staff and fans. No script needed.
Lost at Sheffield United, beat Middlesbrough, then held Wolves.
Non-league to the Championship. Any studio would call that script unrealistic.
